page.heading: Skills

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a reusable block of review instructions. Create one or import a .md / .zip file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to edit, preview or inspect it.

page.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes to this skill. Leave without saving?

detail.loadErrorBody: The skill could not be loaded.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete skill “{name}”? Its versions and agent links are removed. This cannot be undone.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: Write it as a directive: when it applies and what the agent must do.
config.descriptionPlaceholder: When reviewing a PR, score it against…
config.changeNoteHint: Left empty, the note is generated from what changed.

errors.name: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.
errors.nameTaken: Another skill already uses this name.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

evals.title: Evals arrive in M3
evals.body: Eval cases and runs for skills are not available yet.

stats.agentsEmpty: No agent has this skill enabled.
stats.byCategoryEmpty: No findings from runs with this skill in the last 30 days.
stats.attributionHint: Attribution is by presence: a finding counts for every skill that was in its run’s prompt. Last 30 days.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? A new version is created with its content; history is kept.

diff.title: v{from} → current (v{to})
diff.subtitle: Line diff of the snapshot against the current skill.

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Upload a .md file or a .zip archive with a SKILL.md.
import.dropBody: or click to choose a file. Max 1 MB (.md) / 5 MB (.zip).
import.trustWarning: An imported skill is someone else's instructions inside your agent's prompt. Read the body before saving.
import.nameConflict: A skill with this name already exists — rename it before saving.
